comment: Fixed, hand-designed flowchart layout (FR-51). One node per component in SRD §4, under neutral names.

nodes.label: Simulation clock
nodes.does: Single source of time; off at start; play and pause; legible rates.

nodes.label: Barge
nodes.does: Moves along the canal under the timetable. Its position is never recorded.

nodes.label: World generator
nodes.does: Canal, reaches, air masses, fronts and noise; writes the manifest (ground truth).

nodes.label: Sensors (bow, stern)
nodes.does: Sample the world at 1 Hz and write fixed-width records to the logger.

nodes.label: Logger store
nodes.does: Deliberately awkward, append-only fixed-width files; independent of the server.

nodes.label: Store adapter
nodes.does: The only code that understands the logger's format; keeps the server's own index.

nodes.label: Connected Systems server
nodes.does: Discovery, datastreams, observations, control streams; waiting mode; instance identifier.

nodes.label: Analysis service
nodes.does: A process system: derived values, change detection, correlation, clustering.

nodes.label: Seam relay
nodes.does: Service Worker passing HTTP to the backend worker; no logic. Down: a network failure.

nodes.label: Display client
nodes.does: Handshake, profile check, self-configuration, panels. Restartable on its own.

nodes.label: Analyst's workspace
nodes.does: CodeMirror editor and its own Pyodide worker; an ordinary client.

nodes.label: Promoted products
nodes.does: Scientists' scripts registered as process systems with their own datastreams.

nodes.label: ASGI framework
nodes.does: FastAPI and Starlette: routing, validation, OpenAPI.

nodes.label: Browser and Pyodide
nodes.does: Hosts the workers and the relay.

nodes.label: Demonstrator shell
nodes.does: Flowchart, controls, key, tour. Not part of the real system.
